guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：無振動精密實驗平台
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Vibration-isolated precision platforms
guides.concept: 以一張 1000 kg 蜂巢光學桌與四支 1.5 Hz 氣墊隔振腳為主線，說明樓板 VC 等級如何經傳遞率變成桌面奈米級運動，再把桌面模態、主動隔振的傾斜極限、熱與聲學漂移和管線振動短路整合成可量測、可交接的平台驗收紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Follow a 1000 kg honeycomb optical table on four 1.5 Hz pneumatic legs to see how a floor VC class becomes nanometre tabletop motion through transmissibility, then integrate table modes, the tilt limit of active isolation, thermal and acoustic drift and vibration short circuits through hoses into a measurable, transferable platform acceptance record.
procedure: 無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。地面運動以傳遞率 T(f) 傳到桌面：f 遠低於 f₀ 時桌面跟著地面走（T ≈ 1），f = f₀ 時共振放大，只有在 f > √2·f₀ 之後才開始隔振，無阻尼時隨 (f/f₀)⁻² 下降。阻尼壓低共振峰，卻在高頻把衰減斜率從 40 dB/decade 拉回到約 20 dB/decade，因此精密平台必須在共振放大與高頻隔振之間取捨。要把 f₀ 壓到 1 到 2 Hz，靜變形 δ = g/(2πf₀)² 必須達到十公分等級，這是鋼彈簧做不到、改用空氣彈簧的根本原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單自由度隔振器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

平台設計從場址的輸入開始。通用振動準則（VC 曲線）以三分之一倍頻帶的 rms 速度規範樓板：VC-A 50 µm/s、VC-B 25、VC-C 12.5、VC-D 6.25、VC-E 3.12 µm/s，每級減半，在約 1 到 80 Hz 範圍內為定值。以速度定義代表在固定速度下位移 x = v/(2πf) 隨頻率下降，所以低頻的位移最大，也最難隔離。振動之外，空調氣流、聲壓與局部熱源會直接作用在桌面上的元件，不經過隔振器，必須另外列入預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

氣墊隔振腳以橡膠膜片封住加壓氣室，活塞面積 A 承載重量 W = p_g·A，剛度來自氣體壓縮 k = n·p_abs·A²/V，因此自然頻率只取決於壓力比與等效高度 V/A，而與負載大小無關。兩個氣室之間以層流阻尼孔相連，氣體來回流動消耗能量提供阻尼；水平方向則以內部擺桿或膜片側向柔性形成約 1.5 Hz 的擺。機械式水平閥偵測桌面高度，自動補氣或排氣，使不同負載下高度回到原位，但閥的死區與反應時間會影響沉降與漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氣墊隔振腳與水平閥」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

隔振腳決定桌面整體跟地面的關係，桌面本身的彎曲與扭轉模態則決定桌上兩個元件之間的相對運動。蜂巢桌面以上下鋼板夾著薄鋼蜂巢芯，像工字梁一樣把材料放在離中性面最遠處，以低質量換取高彎曲剛度；但金屬結構的內阻尼很小，模態品質因數 Q 可達 100，任何落在共振頻率的力都會被放大。因此桌面內部要加寬頻阻尼器或調諧質量阻尼器，並以動態柔度曲線（位移／力對頻率）描述，而不只看靜態剛度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋼製蜂巢桌面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗證平台需要兩種量測：以地面與桌面的感測器對量傳遞率，以敲擊或激振量動態柔度。低頻量測的難點在感測器雜訊：固定位移下加速度 a = (2πf)²x 隨頻率平方下降，1 Hz 時奈米級位移只對應奈克（ng）級加速度，低於一般壓電加速度計的雜訊底線，必須改用地震級加速度計或速度型地震儀。頻率響應以互功率譜估計 H₁ = S_xy/S_xx，並檢查相干函數；相干性低的頻段代表輸出被其他來源主導，結果不可信。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

平台上的實驗在意的是兩個元件之間的相對位移，而非桌面對地的絕對運動。隔振後，樓板傳入的剛體運動大多是共模，經桌面彎曲轉成的差模極小；真正主導長時間穩定度的是溫度：鋼的熱膨脹係數約 12 ppm/K，空氣折射率隨溫度變化約 −9.3×10⁻⁷/K，氣流與空調週期會讓光程在分鐘尺度漂移。聲壓則透過鏡架與立柱的機械共振直接激振元件，因此預算表要把熱、折射、聲學與殘餘振動分項列出後以 RSS 合成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相對運動誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

被動隔振在 f₀ 附近放大、低於 f₀ 完全無效；主動隔振以慣性感測器量桌面絕對運動，經控制器驅動音圈或壓電致動器把運動抵消，可在 0.5 到 10 Hz 提供 20 到 30 dB 的額外衰減並大幅壓低共振峰，常用於電子顯微鏡、AFM 與微影設備。主動系統的極限來自感測器：水平慣性感測器無法區分水平加速度與地面傾斜造成的重力分量 g·θ，低頻時傾斜雜訊會被當成運動注入桌面。此外，酬載的重心高度、本身的結構共振與桌面耦合，會限制控制頻寬並可能造成不穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動隔振控制迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

實驗室中的平台很少只靠隔振腳支撐：真空管、冷卻水管、電纜與光纖都把桌面和地面或振動源直接相連，形成繞過隔振器的振動短路。這些路徑的剛度與隔振器並聯，提高等效 f₀，更嚴重的是把泵或冷卻機的振動直接送上桌面。安裝時要讓管線以柔性迴圈先錨定在地面或獨立支架上，再接到桌面；驗收則在實際運轉狀態（泵、冷卻機、空調全開）量測桌面頻譜、傳遞率、柔度、沉降時間與溫度漂移，並把基準資料交接給使用者以便日後比對。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「管線、纜線與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m). Ground motion reaches the top through the transmissibility T(f): well below f0 the top follows the ground (T ≈ 1), at f0 it is amplified, and isolation starts only above √2·f0, falling as (f/f0)⁻² when undamped. Damping lowers the resonant peak but at high frequency pulls the roll-off from 40 dB/decade back toward 20 dB/decade, so a precision platform trades resonant amplification against high-frequency isolation. Pushing f0 to 1 to 2 Hz demands a static deflection δ = g/(2πf0)² of order ten centimetres, which steel springs cannot provide and is the basic reason for air springs. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Platform design starts from the site input. The generic vibration criteria (VC curves) specify floor motion as one-third-octave rms velocity: VC-A 50 µm/s, VC-B 25, VC-C 12.5, VC-D 6.25 and VC-E 3.12 µm/s, halving at each step and flat over roughly 1 to 80 Hz. A velocity criterion means displacement x = v/(2πf) falls with frequency at constant velocity, so low frequencies carry the largest displacement and are the hardest to isolate. Beyond vibration, HVAC airflow, sound pressure and local heat sources act directly on components on the tabletop without passing through the isolators and must be budgeted separately. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A pneumatic leg seals a pressurized chamber with a rubber diaphragm; the piston area A carries the weight W = p_g·A, and stiffness comes from gas compression, k = n·p_abs·A²/V, so the natural frequency depends only on the pressure ratio and the effective height V/A, not on the load. Two chambers joined by a laminar damping orifice dissipate energy as gas flows back and forth, and horizontally an internal pendulum or the diaphragm's lateral compliance forms a pendulum near 1.5 Hz. A mechanical leveling valve senses table height and adds or vents air so the height returns under changing loads, but its dead band and response time affect settling and drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The legs set how the whole top follows the ground, but the top's own bending and torsion modes set the relative motion between two components on it. A honeycomb top sandwiches a thin steel honeycomb core between steel skins, placing material far from the neutral plane like an I-beam to buy bending stiffness with little mass; yet metal structures have little internal damping, so modal quality factors reach 100 and any force at a resonance is amplified. Tops therefore include broadband or tuned-mass dampers and are characterized by a dynamic compliance curve, displacement per unit force versus frequency, rather than static stiffness alone. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Steel honeycomb tabletop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Validating a platform takes two measurements: transmissibility from paired floor and tabletop sensors, and dynamic compliance from impact or shaker excitation. The difficulty at low frequency is sensor noise: at fixed displacement the acceleration a = (2πf)²x falls with frequency squared, so nanometre motion at 1 Hz means only nano-g acceleration, below the noise floor of ordinary piezoelectric accelerometers, and seismic-grade accelerometers or velocity seismometers are needed. The frequency response is estimated from cross-spectra as H1 = S_xy/S_xx and checked with the coherence function; bands of low coherence mean the output is dominated by other sources and the result is not trustworthy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Experiments on a platform care about relative displacement between two components, not the top's absolute motion relative to the ground. After isolation, most rigid-body motion from the floor is common-mode and the differential part converted by table bending is tiny; what dominates long-term stability is temperature, since steel expands about 12 ppm/K and the refractive index of air changes about −9.3×10⁻⁷/K, so airflow and HVAC cycles drift optical paths over minutes. Sound pressure drives components directly through mount and post resonances, so the budget lists thermal, refractive, acoustic and residual-vibration terms separately and combines them by RSS. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Relative-motion error budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Passive isolation amplifies near f0 and does nothing below it; active isolation measures the top's absolute motion with inertial sensors and drives voice-coil or piezo actuators to cancel it, adding 20 to 30 dB of attenuation from 0.5 to 10 Hz and suppressing the resonant peak, which is why it is common under electron microscopes, AFMs and lithography tools. Its limit is the sensor: a horizontal inertial sensor cannot distinguish horizontal acceleration from the gravity component g·θ due to ground tilt, so at low frequency tilt noise is read as motion and injected into the top. In addition, payload center-of-gravity height, the payload's own structural resonances and their coupling to the top limit control bandwidth and can cause instability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active isolation control loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

In a real laboratory a platform rarely rests on its legs alone: vacuum hoses, cooling-water lines, cables and fibres tie the top directly to the floor or to vibration sources, forming short circuits that bypass the isolators. Their stiffness acts in parallel with the isolators and raises the effective f0, and worse, they carry pump or chiller vibration straight onto the top. Installation should route lines in compliant loops anchored first to the floor or an independent stand before reaching the top; acceptance then measures the tabletop spectrum, transmissibility, compliance, settling time and thermal drift under real operating conditions with pumps, chillers and HVAC running, and hands the baseline data to users for later comparison. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hoses, cables and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。
用雜訊太高的加速度計量傳遞率，桌面訊號其實是感測器雜訊，算出的傳遞率在 20 Hz 以上變成一條平坦的假底線，讓人誤以為隔振器只有 −20 dB，進而更換本來合格的系統。
pitfallsEn: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway.

Measuring transmissibility with an accelerometer whose noise is too high makes the tabletop signal pure sensor noise, so the computed transmissibility flattens into a false floor above 20 Hz, suggesting the isolators give only −20 dB and prompting replacement of a system that was actually compliant.

related.difference: 本課聚焦傳遞率、氣墊隔振腳、蜂巢桌面柔度、VC 樓板準則與熱聲漂移預算；重力波干涉儀懸吊則以四級擺懸吊的隔振傳遞函數、熔融石英纖維熱雜訊與阻尼控制工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 無振動精密實驗平台
history.text: 1960 年代雷射與全像術出現後，干涉實驗需要次波長級穩定，早期實驗室使用花崗岩板、沙箱或充氣內胎；隨後鋼製蜂巢桌面與氣墊隔振腳商品化，成為光學實驗室的標準配備。1991 年 Colin Gordon 提出通用振動準則 VC 曲線，讓半導體廠與奈米實驗室能以 rms 速度頻譜規範樓板；1990 年代起主動隔振普及到電子顯微鏡與微影設備，Advanced LIGO 更以多級主動平台搭配四段擺，把地面運動壓低多個數量級。本課只重建公開物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: After lasers and holography appeared in the 1960s, interference experiments needed sub-wavelength stability, and early laboratories used granite slabs, sand tables or inflated inner tubes; steel honeycomb tops and pneumatic legs were then commercialized and became standard optical-laboratory equipment. In 1991 Colin Gordon proposed the generic vibration criteria, the VC curves, letting semiconductor fabs and nanotechnology laboratories specify floors as rms velocity spectra; from the 1990s active isolation spread to electron microscopes and lithography tools, and Advanced LIGO combines multi-stage active platforms with quadruple pendulums to suppress ground motion by many orders of magnitude. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.textEn: The course turns "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" through "Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
